record.body:
## Description

Drop the full suite from the three planned dashboard verification tasks. This waits on `budget-instructions` so the replacement commands follow the rule that task writes down.

## Approach

The parent session writes these records. Do not spawn a subagent.

1. `get` each acceptance and `supersede` it. Keep `method` `check`, `effort` `dashboard`, `phase`, and `requirement`. Replace `criterion` and `verify_command`.

   - `rec-69e66203-14dc-40b6-97b6-f751fd52a9fb` (`verify-spec-view-suite`, requirement `R13`, phase `spec-view`). Criterion: the spec-view phase checks pass through the phase screen and the dashboard entry. Command: `uv run --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_phase_screen.py tests/test_dashboard_integration.py -q -k "phase_screen or once"`.
   - `rec-242ca52f-0229-46fb-8334-e9d041b5c06d` (`verify-evidence-matrix-suite`, requirement `R8`, phase `evidence-matrix`). Criterion: the evidence-matrix checks pass. Command: `uv run --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_model.py tests/test_dashboard_requirement.py tests/test_dashboard_phase_screen.py -q -k matrix`.
   - `rec-fea0aa6a-b7e5-4df3-824b-d015bc080c01` (`verify-journal-view-suite`, requirement `R9`, phase `journal-view`). Criterion: the journal-view checks pass. Command: `uv run --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_model.py tests/test_dashboard_journal.py tests/test_dashboard_app.py -q -k journal`.

2. `update` each work-item body with no lifecycle transition. Remove the full-suite step and the words "full suite" from the description. Leave the phase-scoped steps.

   - `rec-79a4e4c1-cfcb-421b-a023-64563ff645f3` (`verify-spec-view`)
   - `rec-8432d854-983c-4de9-bb0f-f99b94ecae9a` (`verify-evidence-matrix`)
   - `rec-f04fa83f-a51f-4800-b3be-9b658df17590` (`verify-journal-view`)

3. Run this task's `verify_command`. It must exit 0.

payload.title: Drop the full suite from planned verification tasks
